name: C11_PI_VERTEX_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_GATE_V1

definition: C is a connected authoritative C11 PI residual component after only frozen deterministic propagation/normalization.
C is NOT_TW3_LIST_READY, with tw(C)>3 certified when needed by a frozen forbidden-minor model.
C is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron eligible for the exact-octahedron terminal.
|V(C)|>=5; this also follows for any tw(C)>3 residual and keeps the standard vertex-connectivity convention unambiguous.
domain.rationale: This gate continues the verified R2 Path-A frontier and asks whether the remaining kappa>=3 interaction factorizes across a separator of exactly three vertices.

base_terminal_stack.L3_READY: Global missing color followed by frozen P7-free List-3.
base_terminal_stack.TW3_LIST_READY: Verified width-3 decomposition followed by frozen arbitrary-list TW3 DP.
base_terminal_stack.LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_READY: Entire component exactly a six-vertex K_{2,2,2}, solved by direct <=4^6 enumeration.

separator3_discovery.Sep_3_C: All unordered 3-subsets S of V(C) such that C-S is disconnected.
separator3_discovery.algorithm: Enumerate all O(n^3) unordered triples S, delete S, compute connected components, retain exactly those with at least two components.

separator_state_semantics.Col_L_S: All assignments psi:S->[4] that respect exact lists and are proper on every edge of C[S].
separator_state_semantics.empty_state_rule: If Col_L(S)=empty, then S is automatically a GOOD_3 separator: no full coloring of C can restrict to a proper list-respecting coloring on S.

closed_definition.formula: Closed(C,S,psi) holds iff after fixing all s in S to psi(s) and applying only frozen deterministic propagation, the branch is CONTRADICTION or every surviving connected component is closed by the base terminal stack.
closed_definition.factorization: For a fixed psi, exact three-vertex separator factorization makes the C-S components independent once all boundary-color restrictions are encoded in propagated lists.

good3_definition.per_separator: GOOD_3(C,S) := S in Sep_3(C) AND [Col_L(S)=empty OR for every psi in Col_L(S): Closed(C,S,psi)].
good3_definition.per_residual: GOOD_3(C) := exists S in Sep_3(C): GOOD_3(C,S).

exact_negation_binding.formula: not GOOD_3(C) iff Sep_3(C)=empty OR for every S in Sep_3(C): [Col_L(S) is nonempty AND exists psi_S in Col_L(S) such that not Closed(C,S,psi_S)].
exact_negation_binding.rule: A single bad 3-separator or a single bad boundary assignment is LOCAL_SEPARATOR3_ESCAPE only and MUST NOT falsify GOOD_3(C).
exact_negation_binding.empty_assignment_consequence: Any S with Col_L(S)=empty is a good separator and blocks the strong negative outcome for that C.

for_each_S: Enumerate every proper list-respecting psi in Col_L(S), at most 64.
Fix psi and apply only frozen deterministic propagation.
If contradiction arises, branch is CLOSED.
Otherwise compute every surviving connected component Q.
Classify each Q in strict order: L3_READY, TW3_LIST_READY, LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_READY, otherwise ESCAPE.
per_separator_audit.branch_closed_iff: Every surviving component is closed by the base terminal stack.

Q1_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.label: Q1_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL
Q1_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.formula: For every C in the frozen domain, GOOD_3(C).
pass_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying universal argument; finite corpus success is insufficient.
A polynomial graph-only method finding at least one good 3-separator S(C) for every domain residual.
For every proper list-respecting boundary assignment psi on S(C), all branches close through the frozen base terminal stack.
Exact SAT reconstruction / UNSAT aggregation over at most 64 separator states.
Polynomial accounting for O(n^3) separator discovery, propagation, component decomposition, and downstream terminals.
Q1_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.consequence_ceiling: The current kappa>=3 authoritative residual family is polynomially resolved by graph-discoverable three-vertex separator composition.

LOCAL_SEPARATOR3_ESCAPE.label: LOCAL_SEPARATOR3_ESCAPE
LOCAL_SEPARATOR3_ESCAPE.formula: exists C, exists S in Sep_3(C), exists psi in Col_L(S): not Closed(C,S,psi).
LOCAL_SEPARATOR3_ESCAPE.interpretation: Only this separator state fails. Another 3-separator may still be universally good; no universal claim is falsified.

Q2_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.label: Q2_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE
Q2_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.strong_formula: exists authoritative C in domain such that Sep_3(C)=empty OR for every S in Sep_3(C), [Col_L(S) nonempty AND exists defeating psi_S with a certified escaping component D_{S,psi_S}].

path_A_no_separator.conclusion: Because the domain independently has Cut(C)=empty, Sep_2(C)=empty, connected |V(C)|>=5, vertex connectivity satisfies kappa(C)>=4.
certificate: complete authoritative C and exact lists
complete graph-only Sep_3(C) enumeration showing empty
path_A_no_separator.equality_ceiling: Do NOT claim kappa(C)=4 unless an explicit 4-vertex separator is separately exhibited.

path_B_all_separators_defeated.condition: Sep_3(C) nonempty and every S in Sep_3(C) has at least one defeating proper list-respecting psi_S.
certificate: for every S, exact nonempty Col_L(S) enumeration receipt
for every S, one defeating psi_S
exact frozen propagation transcript for each defeating state
exact surviving connected D_{S,psi_S} and exact lists
tw(D)>3 with explicit frozen forbidden-minor model
D is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron
independent replay of separator-set completeness and every defeating state

Q2_SEPARATOR3_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.consequence_ceiling: There exists an authoritative kappa>=3 residual whose unresolved interaction is not universally decomposed by any three-vertex separator under the current terminal library.

Q3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: Q3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
Q3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither theorem-level Q1 nor complete strong-Q2 certificate is established.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: TWO_SEPARATOR3_MIXED_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic no-cut1/no-cut2 residual with two 3-separators S1,S2.
required_behavior: S1 has at least one escaping proper boundary assignment.
S2 closes for every proper boundary assignment.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: EMPTY_SEPARATOR3_STATE_CONTROL
required_behavior: Classify S as GOOD_3 by boundary-UNSAT semantics.
No defeating psi is demanded from an empty state set.
Q2=false for any C having this good separator.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: NO_SEPARATOR3_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic connected graph with Cut(C)=empty, Sep_2(C)=empty, Sep_3(C)=empty and a mocked nonterminal label.
required_behavior: only kappa(C)>=4 is concluded; equality is forbidden without a 4-separator.

anti_cheat: Do not stop after the first bad 3-separator when attempting Q2.
Do not promote LOCAL_SEPARATOR3_ESCAPE to Q2.
Do not choose S or psi using extension knowledge.
Do not treat Col_L(S)=empty as an escape; it makes S good.
Do not call failed TW3 heuristic search an escape; require an explicit frozen forbidden-minor certificate.
Do not call an exact literal six-vertex octahedron an escape.
Do not open separator size 4, backdoor size 2, tw4, repair, or new state language.
forbidden: claim kappa(C)=4 without an explicit 4-separator receipt
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only three-vertex separator composition on the frozen no-cut1/no-cut2 frontier and stop at Q1/strong-Q2/Q3.
